items.title: Meet Martini: A Film Set for AI Video That Aims to Help Filmmakers Streamline Their Shots
items.excerpt: Martini is a collaborative, web-based platform pitched as a 'film set' for AI video: filmmakers upload their own sets and reference images or generate them, then compose shots in 2D or 3D environments to escape prompt roulette and give crews a shared pre-production hub. Out now with a free indie tier and paid plans from $15/month.

items.title: Beeble Releases SwitchHDR, an AI Model for HDR Reconstruction From SDR Video
items.excerpt: Beeble's SwitchHDR is an AI frontier model that reconstructs HDR imagery from ordinary SDR video, outputting scene-linear 16-bit EXR sequences for professional post. It targets the reality that most existing footage is SDR while productions increasingly demand HDR-quality assets.

items.title: Tilly Norwood creator developing feature film 'Misaligned' starring the AI actor
items.excerpt: Particle 6, the UK company behind AI-generated 'actor' Tilly Norwood, is developing its first feature, the comedy-drama 'Misaligned,' using a hybrid production model that pairs traditional filmmaking roles with AI specialists — a concrete test of how synthetic-performer pipelines reshape a production.

items.title: NEW AI Film Tools: The Biggest Updates for Artists
items.excerpt: Curious Refuge rounds up the week's biggest AI filmmaking releases for artists, with a focus on new AI motion-control workflows and tool updates that change how creators direct and refine AI-generated shots.
